subject: School Committee Charter Provisions
overview: The subcommittee reviewed interview feedback from municipal leaders and drafted pros and cons regarding School Committee term lengths, ward representation, term limits, and the role of the mayor. No formal votes were taken.

items.title: Interview with Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn
items.summary: Van der Kloot presented notes from an interview with Mayor Lungo-Koehn, who expressed support for three-year terms across city offices, supported term limits, favored remaining as School Committee chair, and suggested combining wards to keep committee size manageable.

items.title: Interview with Former Superintendent Roy Belson
items.summary: Van der Kloot summarized an interview with former superintendent Roy Belson, who advocated for the mayor serving as chair for budget accountability, favored at-large representation, and opposed term limits.

items.title: Written Feedback from Current School Committee Members
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed written feedback from members Aaron Olapade and Paul Rousseau addressing term lengths, at-large elections, term limits, and whether the mayor should serve as chair.

items.title: Pros and Cons of School Committee Governance Options
items.summary: Members drafted a working chart evaluating pros and cons for ward versus at-large and hybrid representation, two-, three-, and four-year terms, term limits, and whether the mayor should serve as a member or chair.

items.title: Student Observer and Local Journalism Discussion
items.summary: Northeastern University journalism student Naya Plinton introduced herself, prompting discussion on local municipal reporting and engagement.

items.title: Future Planning and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The subcommittee agreed to review Article 4 of comparable municipal charters section by section at future meetings and scheduled their next meeting for March 5, 2024.
